summary: MediCar Plus v2.1.7 PRE-LAUNCH exhaustive testing. All critical flows verified end-to-end. Backend: 81/81 pytest passed (added new /app/backend/tests/test_prelaunch_v217.py with 9 tests covering SMS lifecycle, CSV preview, calendar sync, SPA artifacts). Frontend: master license activation (MB-MASTER-BRUGULAT-2026-OWNER) → setup empresas (Tráfico + Revisiones) → dashboard reached; btnPrint uses window.print(); Settings modal (Idioma, Actualitzacions, Empreses, Contactar amb suport, Sortir) — NO Diagnóstico URL panel; IRPF modal opens with correct UI (empresa switcher, month nav, IRPF% presets, table structure, Imprimir mes); SMS import CSV works (3 válidos, 1 duplicado detected correctly), campaign create → send succeeds in mock mode; URL auto-discovery recovers from DEAD-URL.invalid in ~4s to a valid preview URL. Backend regression tests updated for v2.1.7 version bumps (electron package.json 2.1.x, stripe prices 29.9/299.9/39.9/399.9, print helpers refactored to printVisibleElement+printHtml).
action_items: OPTIONAL: sms-search data-testid only renders inside campaign-detail view (not preview view). Consider adding it also to the top of the preview list for a consistent search UX. Not blocking.

OPTIONAL: When IRPF modal opens for a company/month for the first time, the code auto-seeds default persons via seedIrpfMonth(). This is a UX choice — verify Marc wants pre-seed vs empty start. Not a bug.

The line 2924 `$('#btnPrint').onclick=()=>window.print();` uses the browser's NATIVE print dialog (not the new WYSIWYG preview modal). Confirmed by intercepting: window.print was called exactly once. This is the daily cash print — @media print CSS filters the UI. If Marc wants unified preview modal with 'Guardar PDF' button here too, wrap the current dashboard section in printVisibleElement(el).
critical_code_review_comments: printHtml() at v2.html:607-663 correctly creates iframe with data-print-frame='1', writes html via doc.open/write/close, and calls contentWindow.print() on button clicks — bulletproof for Electron.

printVisibleElement() at v2.html:675-743 is defensive: replaces <input>/<textarea>/<select> with static <span>, strips buttons/[data-no]/[data-close]/[contenteditable], forces @page A4 landscape + inline styles. Handles cases where clone contains elements not in a modal.

IRPF calc formula (line 2200-2209) uses correct SS deduction: total=hasSs?brut-ss:brut, irpf=total*rate, net=total-irpf, totalFinal=hasSs?net+netSs:net. This gives the requested 100×4.50=450, TOTAL=400, IRPF@15%=60, NET=340, TOTAL FINAL=400 (netSs=60).

IRPF input debouncing at line 2453-2459 correctly avoids focus-loss: full render is scheduled only 800ms after typing pauses AND is skipped if activeElement is still an IRPF input. Live cell updates happen inline without re-rendering the table.
SMS preview endpoint (routes/sms_campaigns.py:129-222) handles duplicates, invalid mobiles, missing phones — verified via 4-row CSV: 3 valid + 1 duplicate correctly classified.
SMS campaigns require X-Admin-Token (line 45-48 sms_campaigns.py). The v2.html apiSms() at line 3574 automatically includes this header on all /sms/* calls — verified working end-to-end.

URL auto-discovery at v2.html:5019+ correctly recovers from a stale/dead cache key. Verified: seeded caja.apibase.v1='https://DEAD-URL.invalid', reloaded, and localStorage was overwritten with a valid preview URL within 4-5s.

v2.html file size: 5468 lines. This is above the 700-line recommended threshold but is a deliberate single-file architecture for Electron packaging. Not blocking for launch. Post-launch refactor into ES modules (billing/, print/, sms/, calendar/, license/) recommended.

backend/server.py:20 EMERGENT_LLM_KEY falls back to empty string. Comment says 'fail fast' but code doesn't raise. Since /api/ai-ask has graceful error path (returns error message), this is safe but the comment should be updated. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified: activation, setup, dashboard, print, settings, IRPF UI, SMS CSV preview + campaign send, URL auto-discovery)
